razonamiento: The architecture shows Main Street America (an American Family Group company) modernizing a legacy Tomcat application. Independent insurance agents access a single-page application hosted in S3 through CloudFront. Backend API calls route through CloudFront to Amazon API Gateway, which first invokes a Lambda authorizer to authenticate users, then forwards requests to serverless Python Lambdas. The Lambda interacts with Amazon DynamoDB to cache regional user session state across Availability Zones and connects bidirectionally to legacy Tomcat services still running on EC2 for un-migrated functionality.
nombre: American Family Group Legacy Application Modernization
